snippet.title: Flak Attack (PC, Windows 3.x) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gameplay of Flak Attack, an action video game developed and released by the Dreamers Guild (yes, the same company that made the cult classic "I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream" for the MS-DOS in 1995, try wrapping your head around this little fun fact).

A horde of robot commandos are attacking your base from the skies above. You control a single gun to fight the invaders, but you need to be careful not to run out of ammunition, or your base will certainly be destroyed.

Fortunately, you are not alone: friendly UN helicopters will pass by in regular intervals to drop ammo crates to replenish your cannon. Also, when you destroy a satellite or aircraft, the flak created by the explosion can create a chain reaction, allowing you to destroy multiple enemies at once with some well aimed and timed shots.
